title: Browse decoded interface tile sheets
changes: Add paginated 4-bit views of extracted UI graphics banks with grayscale or manually selected UI palette banks.
Allow source selectors and language IDs to open linked UI banks, while labeling links outside the catalog and incomplete trailing tile words.
validation: Synthetic Linux Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-uitiles-wzgtb2u7 checked pixel colors, palette subbanks, pagination, selector links and missing links; unit hegdmdgx checked the shared background renderer.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-uitiles-eur-bsaejp9_ compared all 56 UI graphics banks, 22 palette banks and 11 selectors and checked independent reference pixels and navigation in Chrome.
limitations: Some decoded words are not necessarily pixels; the 4-bit display and manually chosen palettes do not establish a game pairing or reconstruct a complete screen.
